title: us_short_exclusion_summary_public
description: De-identified, TRACKABLE weekly exclusion summary (docs/us_short_system_design.md §11.4): public-universe per-category exclusion counts + hot_excluded heat and unevaluable counts ONLY. It carries NO tickers / holdings / $ — real-holding exclusions live on the PRIVATE path (§11.6, §18.0 guard). The de-identification GATE is this schema itself: additionalProperties:false at the top level + integer-only counts mean no ticker / holding / cost field can ever land on a tracked path.
